verses.original: Πρεσβυτέρους τοὺς ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός
verses.transliteration: Presbyterous tous en hymin parakalō ho sympresbyteros kai martys tōn tou Christou pathēmatōn ho kai tēs mellousēs apokalyptesthai doxēs koinōnos
verses.literal: As a fellow elder a witness of Christ’s sufferings and a partaker of the glory to be revealed I appeal to the elders among you

verses.original: ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως κατὰ Θεόν μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως
verses.transliteration: poimanate to en hymin poimnion tou Theou episkopountes mē anankastōs alla hekousiōs kata Theon mēde aischrokerdōs alla prothymōs
verses.literal: Be shepherds of God’s flock that is among you watching over them not out of compulsion but willingly as God would have you not out of greed but out of eagerness

verses.original: μηδ’ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου
verses.transliteration: mēd’ hōs katakyrieuontes tōn klērōn alla typoi ginomenoi tou poimniou
verses.literal: not lording it over those entrusted to you but being examples to the flock

verses.original: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ Ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον
verses.transliteration: kai phanerōthentos tou Archipoimenos komieisthe ton amarantinon tēs doxēs stephanon
verses.literal: And when the Chief Shepherd appears you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away

verses.original: Ὁμοίως νεώτεροι ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις πάντες δὲ ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε ὅτι Ὁ Θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs neōteroi hypotagēte presbyterois pantes de allēlois tēn tapeinophrosynēn enkombōsasthe hoti Ho Theos hyperēphanois antitassetai tapeinois de didōsin charin
verses.literal: Young men in the same way submit yourselves to your elders And all of you clothe yourselves with humility toward one another because God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble

verses.original: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ
verses.transliteration: Tapeinōthēte oun hypo tēn krataian cheira tou Theou hina hymas hypsōsē en kairō
verses.literal: Humble yourselves therefore under God’s mighty hand so that in due time He may exalt you

verses.original: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπ’ αὐτόν ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: pasan tēn merimnan hymōn epiripsantes ep’ auton hoti autō melei peri hymōn
verses.literal: Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you

verses.original: Νήψατε γρηγορήσατε ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν
verses.transliteration: Nēpsate grēgorēsate ho antidikos hymōn diabolos hōs leōn ōryomenos peripatei zētōn tina katapiein
verses.literal: Be sober-minded and alert Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion seeking someone to devour

verses.original: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: hō antistēte stereoi tē pistei eidotes ta auta tōn pathēmatōn tē en tō kosmō hymōn adelphotēti epiteleisthai
verses.literal: Resist him standing firm in your faith and in the knowledge that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kinds of suffering

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Θεὸς πάσης χάριτος ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς καταρτίσει στηρίξει σθενώσει θεμελιώσει
verses.transliteration: Ho de Theos pasēs charitos ho kalesas hymas eis tēn aiōnion autou doxan en Christō oligon pathontas autos katartisei stērixei sthenōsei themeliōsei
verses.literal: And after you have suffered for a little while the God of all grace who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ will Himself restore you secure you strengthen you and establish you

verses.original: αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: autō to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: To Him be the power forever and ever Amen

verses.original: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ὡς λογίζομαι δι’ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ εἰς ἣν στῆτε
verses.transliteration: Dia Silouanou hymin tou pistou adelphou hōs logizomai di’ oligōn egrapsa parakalōn kai epimartyrōn tautēn einai alēthē charin tou Theou eis hēn stēte
verses.literal: Through Silvanus whom I regard as a faithful brother I have written to you briefly encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God Stand firm in it

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μάρκος ὁ υἱός μου
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai hymas hē en Babylōni syneklektē kai Markos ho huios mou
verses.literal: The church in Babylon chosen together with you sends you greetings . . . as does my son Mark

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati agapēs Eirēnē hymin pasin tois en Christō
verses.literal: Greet one another with a kiss of love Peace to all of you who are in Christ
